SELECT b.id as batchId, b.number as batchNumber, b.time as createTime, b.nums as nums, b.goods as goodsId, b.room as room,
r.id as "warehouseStock.storedRecordId", r.warehouse as "warehouseStock.warehouseId", w.name as "warehouseStock.warehouseName", r.goods as "warehouseStock.goodsId", r.attr as "warehouseStock.attrId", r.nums as "warehouseStock.stockNum" FROM batch b LEFT JOIN room r ON b.goods = r.goods LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON r.warehouse = w.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.goods = g.id WHERE b.goods IN
#{goodsId}
AND b.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNumber}, '%')
AND b.time = #{query.productDate}
AND b.nums < g.threshold
AND b.nums > 0
AND r.nums > 0 ORDER BY b.time DESC, r.warehouse

SELECT bi.id as id, bi.pid as pid, b.goods as goodsId, g.protect as protectDays,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN buy.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN sell.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN bre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN swap.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN entry.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN extry.mfd ELSE b.time END as produceDate,
CASE WHEN g.protect > 0 THEN DATE_ADD( CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN buy.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN sell.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN bre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN swap.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN entry.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN extry.mfd ELSE b.time END, INTERVAL g.protect DAY ) ELSE NULL END as expireDate,
CASE WHEN bi.direction = 1 THEN ABS(bi.nums) ELSE -ABS(bi.nums) END as nums,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN buy.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN sell.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN bre.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sre.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN CASE WHEN bi.direction = 1 THEN swap.storehouse ELSE swap.warehouse END WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN entry.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN extry.warehouse ELSE NULL END as "warehouseStock.warehouseId",
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN w_buy.name WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN w_sell.name WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN w_bre.name WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN w_sre.name WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN CASE WHEN bi.direction = 1 THEN w_swap_in.name ELSE w_swap_out.name END WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN w_entry.name WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN w_extry.name ELSE NULL END as "warehouseStock.warehouseName" FROM batch_info bi LEFT JOIN batch b ON bi.pid = b.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.goods = g.id
LEFT JOIN buy_info buy ON bi.info = buy.id AND bi.type = 'buy' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_buy ON buy.warehouse = w_buy.id
LEFT JOIN sell_info sell ON bi.info = sell.id AND bi.type = 'sell' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_sell ON sell.warehouse = w_sell.id
LEFT JOIN bre_info bre ON bi.info = bre.id AND bi.type = 'bre' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_bre ON bre.warehouse = w_bre.id
LEFT JOIN sre_info sre ON bi.info = sre.id AND bi.type = 'sre' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_sre ON sre.warehouse = w_sre.id
LEFT JOIN swap_info swap ON bi.info = swap.id AND bi.type = 'swap' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_swap_out ON swap.warehouse = w_swap_out.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w_swap_in ON swap.storehouse = w_swap_in.id
LEFT JOIN entry_info entry ON bi.info = entry.id AND bi.type = 'entry' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_entry ON entry.warehouse = w_entry.id
LEFT JOIN extry_info extry ON bi.info = extry.id AND bi.type = 'extry' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_extry ON extry.warehouse = w_extry.id WHERE bi.pid IN
#{batchId}
ORDER BY bi.pid, produceDate DESC, bi.direction DESC
